For My Princess Isra 💗

I don't need perfect words to explain what you mean to me. Your smile, your little moments, and the way you are yourself make you genuinely special to me. I just want you to always feel cared for, respected, and appreciated. 💞

I'm grateful that Allah made you and brought you into my life. I promise I'll try my best to stay loyal, caring, and honest, and I hope we can always give each other the same care, understanding, and respect.

— Always caring for you 💗
